source_issues.description: Actual available fault current, source voltage/transients and impedance, protected-device withstand, wiring limits, and acceptable disconnection behavior are missing. Component interrupt rating and typical melting I2t do not establish safe system protection or coordination.

Continuous and inrush current waveforms, pulse repetition, ambient, board mounting and thermal margin are unknown. Average pre-arcing curves and typical melting I2t do not establish repetitive-pulse endurance; operating range alone does not establish permitted load current.

Exact SF-1206S050-2 and electrical Rev. 10/26 only; legal appendix K2540 08/26R is separate. Clearing at 250 percent/25 C and reliability fusing at 200 percent retain distinct scopes, not a manufactured conflict. Reliability-row ambient, AC rating, guaranteed total clearing I2t, derating tolerance and full-temperature resistance bound remain unknown; no circuit safety certification inferred.
